zh-CN.title: 广场人物四肢拥有独立入口
items: 广场人物 Drawer 新增独立的四肢 Tab，与衣服、手持物和动作并列
四肢选项不再收纳在衣服页面中，人物定制路径更加直接
切换四肢时顶部人物预览即时更新，点击右上角保存后正式生效

en.title: Plaza character limbs now have their own tab
items: The plaza character drawer now includes a dedicated Limbs tab alongside Outfit, Prop, and Motion
Limb choices are no longer nested under Outfit, making character customization more direct
The sticky character preview updates instantly, while the top-right Save action applies the final choice
